_comment: API routes that no screen is meant to call: they serve other programs, links in emails, or sign-in itself. Each pattern needs a reason. `/**` matches everything beneath a path.

routes./api/v1/**: The public REST API, called with an API key.
routes./api/mcp: The MCP server endpoint, called by MCP clients.
routes./api/oauth/**: OAuth for MCP clients: discovery, registration, token exchange.
routes./api/auth/[...nextauth]: NextAuth's own handler, reached through its client library.
routes./api/t/**: Open and click tracking and the unsubscribe page, reached from links inside sent emails.
routes./api/health: Liveness and readiness probe for the container platform.
routes./api/inbox: The reply list in the shape it had before conversations. The inbox screen reads /api/conversations; this is kept for the MCP tool inbox_list and for scripts written against it.
routes./api/inbox/reply: Send an email by address without naming a conversation. Kept for the MCP tool inbox_send_email; the screen sends through /api/conversations/[id]/send.
routes./api/inbox/thread: A contact's email thread in the shape it had when it was read from the mailbox. Kept for the MCP tool reply_intelligence_manage; the screen reads /api/conversations/[id].
routes./api/inbox/sync: Start or report a mailbox check alone. Kept for the MCP tool reply_intelligence_manage; the screen uses /api/conversations/sync, which also asks for the LinkedIn inboxes.
routes./api/inbox/reclassify-all: Read every reply that has no verdict yet, in bulk. An operator's tool, reached through the MCP tool reply_intelligence_manage.
routes./api/inbox/backfill: An older name for /api/inbox/reclassify-all, kept so calls written against it still work.
